subject: POC trial planning - RACI & success criteria (Clearwater Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearwaterhealth.org>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial planning - recap + next steps

Hi Sam/Priya — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the POC trial scope and owners. Feel free to edit.

1) Success criteria (what Clearwater will consider a win):
- End-to-end inference latency under 250ms p50 for your 99th-percentile query mix (same model/config we demo'd).
- < 20% token-cost reduction vs current baseline using Redwood batching + caching over a 2-week evaluation.
- No PII leakage in outputs; pass the attached red-team prompt set and the security questionnaire.

2) Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0 (now): finalize PoC scope + sign MSA addendum (if needed).
- Week 1: Environment setup (private VPC link for telemetry and model access), ingest sample dataset, run baseline.
- Week 2: Run Redwood-instrumented trials and collect latency/cost metrics.
- Week 3: Results review, handoff to infra/security for go/no-go.

3) Proposed RACI / stakeholder mapping (first pass):
- Customer App Owner (Responsible): Sam Torres (Clearwater) — define product-level success criteria and test cases.
- Customer Security (Consulted): Priya Menon (Clearwater) — run questionnaire, red-team prompts, provide access controls.
- Customer Procurement (Informed/Accountable for purchase): procurement@clearwaterhealth.org — contracts and billing.
- Redwood Infra Lead (Responsible): Aditya Rao — configure Dedicated/Private endpoints, networking, and KV cache settings.
- Redwood SE (Responsible/Execute): Lauren Bishop — integrate SDK, run eval harness, collect metrics.
- Redwood CS (Accountable): Rachel Kim — overall project coordination and success sign-off.

4) Open questions we need from you to finalize scope:
- Who will own providing the sample dataset and a representative query log?
- Any specific compliance constraints (data residency, logging windows) we should account for?
- Preferred timeline for running the 2-week evaluation window?

Attachments: poc_scope.pdf (scope & success criteria), security_questionnaire_clearwater.xlsx, poc_timeline_v1.xlsx

Next step: If this looks good, would you be available for a 30-min alignment call Tues 6/30 at 10am PT? I’ll loop in Procurement if you want us to start contracting simultaneously.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearwaterhealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: Jeff Caldwell <jeff.caldwell@clearwaterhealth.org>
Date: 2026-06-29T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - recap + next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. This is very helpful. A few notes: 

- Success criteria: agree on latency and cost targets; we'll add an accuracy check for top-1 intent classification on the sample set (~> 92% threshold).
- Dataset/logs: Jeff will own providing sanitized query logs and a 5k-sample dataset by EOD Monday (6/29).
- Security/compliance: Priya flagged that we need to ensure logs are retained 90 days and that audit logs are sent to our SIEM (Splunk). Can Redwood ship audit logs to a customer endpoint?

On RACI, one change: our Infrastructure owner for network peering and firewall rules is in IT — I'll loop them in on the alignment call. Procurement will need an initial SOW and T&Cs to review; I'll introduce procurement@clearwaterhealth.org after we confirm scope.

Yes — Tue 6/30 10am PT works for us. Please send calendar invite.

— Sam
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearwaterhealth.org>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Jeff Caldwell <jeff.caldwell@clearwaterhealth.org>
Date: 2026-06-29T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - recap + next steps

Great — thanks Sam. Quick answers: 
- Audit logs: yes, we can stream audit/event logs to a customer-managed endpoint (Splunk) and we will include log retention controls in the SOW.
- We'll treat the 90-day retention as the default for the PoC unless you require otherwise.

Lauren/Aditya/Rachel — looping you in to confirm scope items below before the call: 
- Lauren: can you prepare the integration checklist + what we need from the app side to run the eval harness?
- Aditya: can you confirm the network/connectivity options for a private deployment and estimated time to provision peering (ballpark)?
- Rachel: I'll need a short SOW template and SSO/data processing addendum to send to procurement after scope confirmation.

I've attached the SOW template and a first-pass timeline. See you all on Tue 6/30 10am PT — calendar invite sent.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - recap + next steps

Quick checklist from SE side for the PoC (what we need from Clearwater):
- Sample query log (5k) + label file for accuracy checks (Jeff will provide).
- Representative dataset (S3 link or secure transfer).
- A staging service account with limited API access or temporary credentials for Redwood SE to run integration tests.
- Network: list of allowed IPs / CIDR or confirmation to proceed with VPC peering.

I'll prepare the eval harness (latency/cost/accuracy dashboard) and allocate a SE engineer to run the first-pass tests. Tentative owner: Lauren Bishop (execute).

I’ll upload the integration checklist to the Drive link and post it in the calendar invite.

— Lauren
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-30T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - recap + next steps

Heads up on provisioning: for a private deployment + VPC peering we typically need 3-5 business days to provision and validate peering once we have the network CIDRs and firewall rules. If you prefer a faster path, we can run the PoC on a dedicated hosted instance with secure tunneling which can be ready in 24-48 hours (tradeoff: more restricted telemetry access).

I'll prepare the exact network checklist (CIDR, allowed ports, BGP or static routes) and post to the shared Drive. Proposed owner: Aditya Rao (infra/configuration).

— Aditya
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@clearwaterhealth.org>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearwaterhealth.org>
Cc: procurement@clearwaterhealth.org, Jeff Caldwell <jeff.caldwell@clearwaterhealth.org>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - recap + next steps

Thanks everyone — alignment looks good. A couple clarifying items from Security/Procurement: 

- Please confirm Redwood's default data retention policy for logs (we requested 90 days for PoC).
- We'll need the signed DPA and the security questionnaire completed prior to ingesting any sample data.
- Procurement requests an initial SOW and a rough cost estimate for a 2-week trial and a 3-month pilot (if we proceed).

I'll wait for the SOW and questionnaire from Marissa/Rachel and will route to procurement once received.

Best — Priya
Clearwater Health — Security
